note: two self-consistent instruments: each pose set fuses its own surface from the same depth maps and counts its own coverage (700-frame stride-12 budget, 4 mm tolerance). The GT-pose instrument isolates what the statistic reads with perfect tracking; the gap is the tracking-attributable coverage error, and the GT-pose residual reflects genuine non-inspection plus depth error.
summary: GT-pose instrument: 39.9-42.0% under-seen across all three withdrawals (two colon models) - the clinical thesis with tracking error removed. Pipeline deviation from it: -5.1 to +13.1 points = the measured tracking-attributable coverage error band.
